title: Versus
tagline: Versus is a multiplayer survival fps game. Play and earn token rewards directly on-chain.

prizes.title: Best dApp built on Saga Chainlet

description:
Versus is a cross-platform survival game where players stake tokens to begin a session and compete with friends. The last survivor earns on-chain token rewards. Built on a dedicated Saga Chainlet, Versus ensures high-performance, gasless transactions using Saga’s recycled gas token model.
We developed a custom SDK to integrate the Saga Chainlet and smart contracts, allowing full tokenization of game mechanics. Our solution showcases the power of scalable, user-friendly Web3 gaming through seamless gameplay, zero-gas UX, and true ownership via on-chain rewards.
how_its_made:
Game Engine: Built using Meta Horizon’s desktop editor for VR, desktop, and mobile compatibility.
On-Chain Integration: Developed a custom SDK using Next.js to integrate with Saga Chainlet, enabling seamless smart contract interactions.

Smart Contracts: Deployed on a dedicated EVM-compatible Saga Chainlet, handling staking, game start, and reward distribution.

Gasless UX: Leveraged Saga’s recycled gas tokens to provide zero-gas transactions for players.

Tokenization: Game sessions and rewards are fully on-chain, ensuring transparency, immutability, and real ownership of in-game achievements.

Multiplayer Logic: Syncs player states and survival outcomes, allowing for real-time competition and reward flow.
